Later Channel-9 cells use the implemented 2270 ms report-service allowance. Retries, alternate routes, and pair work may continue past the right edge.

Hard rule: a probe stays inside its exact stable enumeration slot. Soft rule: a child delays only its first connection attempt, ordered by hop depth and then stable slot.
